title: Trigonometry in Math - GeeksforGeeks
content:
Trigonometry is a branch of mathematics that explores the relationships between the ratios of the sides of a right-angled triangle and its angles. We use it in many everyday situations, often without even noticing.

  • Construction and Architecture: Trigonometry helps calculate angles and heights when designing buildings, bridges, and roads. For example, architects use it to determine roof slopes or the angle of staircases.
  • Navigation: Pilots and sailors use it to find their way. By calculating distances and angles between landmarks or stars, they can determine their location and the best route to follow.
  • Engineering: Engineers use it for designing machines, cars, or tunnels. For example, ensuring roads curve at safe angles for vehicles.
